chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from Ibn Abi Umayr, from some of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The woman shortens her hair for her Umrah by the amount of a finger-joint. And it is from the Sunnah that he begins at the forehead from the right horn and shaves up to the two bones.
ai.seo_question: How much hair should a woman cut during Umrah and what is the Sunnah method for men?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the distinct ritual grooming requirements for men and women during Umrah, highlighting the Shia emphasis on the Sunnah method of shaving for men by starting at the right front of the head. The mention of 'some of our companions' reflects the typical Isnad structure in Tusi's compilation, while the specific measurement of 'anmulah' (finger-joint) provides a precise fiqh benchmark for female pilgrims. This distinction underscores the jurisprudential nuance between the obligatory acts and recommended practices in Shia ritual law.
